title: Make readings state GitHub Actions cache branch scoping for CI work
summary: Add one rule to the reader prompt (reader.md): when a request touches CI caching or CI speed, the reading explains how the GitHub Actions cache is scoped by branch and states that constraint in an acceptance criterion. Add a unit test in athena-context showing the prompt names it. Audience: the maintainer reviewing readings. The reader set has only 3 tokens of headroom, so the producer must trim existing reader.md wording to fit within the unchanged 2000-token budget.

defaults_applied.how: New unit test; cargo test and clippy must pass.
Verifier runs cargo test, clippy and fmt --check.
Test asserts the prompt wording is present.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs (READER_FRAME includes ../prompts/reader.md; BudgetSet::Reader budget is 2_000; existing tests compose frames and call check_budget) and crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs and crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs (reader budget line). The change adds no record or data file, so check_record_file and AnyRecord are not involved. The property is measured directly on READER_FRAME.text, not a stand-in.
The reader set has 3 tokens left, so the new bullet (about 40-60 tokens) requires trimming equivalent tokens from reader.md; raising the budget is not assumed.
Cache scoping facts (GitHub docs): restore from current branch, base branch, default branch; not from sibling branches.
The 'fixture' requested is satisfied by a unit test on the prompt text.

acceptance_criteria.text: crates/athena-context/prompts/reader.md has a bullet saying that when a request touches CI caching or CI speed, the reading states how the GitHub Actions cache is scoped by branch and puts that constraint in an acceptance criterion.

The bullet states the scoping correctly: a run restores caches from its own branch (or PR merge ref), its base branch, and the default branch; it cannot restore caches from sibling or unrelated branches; caches saved by a feature branch are not visible to the default branch or other branches.

A new test in crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs asserts READER_FRAME.text names the CI cache, branch scoping, base/default branch and acceptance criterion. Run `cargo test -p athena-context`: it passes, and it would fail if the bullet were removed.

The reader token budget is unchanged at 2000 (BudgetSet::Reader in crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs); existing wording is tightened so the existing budget tests still pass. Run `cargo test -p athena-context` and `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets`.
No other prompt set exceeds its budget and the whole workspace is healthy. Run `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` (clean) and `cargo fmt --check`.
Governance files (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) are not changed; the existing guidance in reader.md is trimmed only in wording, not in meaning.

out_of_scope: Changing CI workflows or actual cache configuration
Raising token budgets in athena.toml or lib.rs
departures: Slightly lower cost than reference: small prompt edit, but the 3-token headroom may force retries.
